blind.description: A stylized wooden mounted crossbow trap or miniature ballista. It consists of a splayed multi-legged timber stand reinforced with metal bands and rivets, holding a heavy wooden stock with green-painted channel inserts. A dark curved metal bow prod is fixed near the front, strung with a taught cord drawn back into a trigger mechanism. A single bolt with a silver spear-like tip and red fletching rests loaded on the rail.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it displays the curved arch of the front metal bow with the taut string forming a sharp V-shape leading back to the release mechanism. The wooden rail with green inlay runs horizontally, carrying a red-feathered bolt pointing left, while the splayed wooden legs protrude beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% as tall as the figure (approx. 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft wide.
